ask: Announce version 2.4 in our Discord, in the same channel as the last release note: faster exports and a new calendar view.

steps.why: The channel comes from the post the user pointed at; no tool lists channels. Without one the post schedules and then fails.

arguments.content: Version 2.4 is out: faster exports and a new calendar view.

discord.embed_description:
Faster exports.
A new calendar view.

steps.why: The message text, used as is if the embed ever goes. The decision: an embed, because a release note has a title and a list worth setting apart; a chat-style update would stay plain text. With embed_description set, the embed replaces the message text; without it the text would show twice. Only the two changes the user named, nothing invented. The footer is a details-only key, so every Discord setting goes in platform_details on the saving call itself. The channel id is Bolta's own, as the read gave it. Read the result's platform_details.discord: a refused Discord field leaves the draft saved without it.

say: Saved to Acme as a Discord draft for the same channel as the last release note, as an embed titled "Acme 2.4": faster exports, and a new calendar view. Nothing goes out yet. Post it now or schedule it?
never: A channel name or id the user didn't point to.
An embed with no description: the text shows twice.
Promising a role ping: mentions aren't sent from here.
